about: Scan order. The Brain Dump doc comes first even though Areas/ sorts before it by path. Inside it: the lines above the first date heading form a piece with heading null, which goes first; then the date headings oldest first, whatever order the note holds them in (the note has 2026-10-02, 2026-09-21, then 2026-09-28, the last at heading level 2). Then the other story notes by path: Areas/area-mara.md, Ideas/idea-cliff-scene.md, Ideas/idea-harrow-point.md, Ideas/idea-tobias.md, each a whole-note piece with heading null. A note's kind is whichever story kind its type list holds, in any position (migrator-rules.md 01.8, 2026-10-27): idea-cliff-scene's list is [scene-note, idea-note], so it is an Idea Note; idea-tobias's starts with idea-note; its new comment counts all 3 bullets. Total size 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 3 = 11: one batch. Not story notes, so fingerprinted and never scanned or copied, though each holds a tagged bullet: Ideas/scratch.md (no frontmatter) and Plot/plot-outline.md. llm-files/ is never covered: not scanned, copied, or fingerprinted.
